segments.text: A woodpecker bangs its head on trees all day,
So its brain is fine, right?
In 2018, scientists checked woodpecker brains kept in museums.
They found clumps of a protein called tau.
In football players, that kind of buildup is linked to brain damage from years of hits.
Blackbirds, which don't peck, showed none.
So is it damage, or protection?
